description: This file provides a PHP-based implementation for session management using a database backend. It includes functions for opening, closing, reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting sessions, with encryption support for session data. The file also contains configuration setup instructions and dependencies on other modules.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: A class responsible for encrypting and decrypting session data using MD5-based cryptography, used to secure session storage.

methods.name: ADODB_Session_Key
methods.description: Generates an encrypted session key for crypted sessions using a defined cryptographic key and session ID.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Initializes the database connection for session handling, establishing a persistent connection for subsequent session operations.

methods.name: adodb_sess_close
methods.description: Closes the database connection used for session storage.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database corresponding to a given session key, decrypting the data if necessary.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Writes session data to the database with encryption and expiration timestamp handling.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Deletes a session from the database, optionally triggering notifications.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by removing expired sessions and optimizing the session table.
